description:
Add a built-in codex runner type. Extend RunnerConfigSchema with: type: 'codex', optional model override. Implement CodexRunner in src/runner/codex.ts implementing AgentRunner.

Codex CLI is invoked as: codex "<rendered prompt>" with the repo as cwd and OPENAI_API_KEY (or configurable env var) in the environment. Use the same prompt rendering approach as the Claude runner (task + context + git instructions) but drop --output-format json since Codex CLI outputs plain text. Capture stdout as the summary (truncated to 500 chars).

Config env var for the API key should be configurable (default: OPENAI_API_KEY). Update config schema, loader, and runner factory. Share the prompt rendering logic with T-043 — extract it into src/runner/prompt.ts so both runners use the same context-to-prompt function.
title: Built-in Codex runner
